implementation_ontology.support_boundary: The named study runs 4096 particles through 32 displacement steps in a 21x21 grid with radius 0.5. Nontrivial initial fractions and distinct deterministic X/Y displacements cover particles inside/outside circles, grid boundaries and particles outside the grid. The first 64 particles start beyond either grid edge. Original native GPU/CPU functions and original CUDA.jl kernel are preserved. Every final X/Y coordinate and every per-particle grid counter, including untouched cells, is checked: 1814528 values. All values compare exactly to both references in all five trials. The scalar CPU oracles additionally require every UInt64 visit count to match exactly and positions within 1e-5, strengthening the original aggregate-map-only evidence. The Float64 artifact losslessly widens Float32 coordinates and bounded counts<=32 outside timing; device coordinates remain Float32 and counters UInt64.
